name: Raja Ampat
about: Oct–Apr has the calmest seas and clearest diving, the southeast monsoon (Jun–Sep) brings rougher water.
overview: Peak marine and bird biodiversity on Earth — some of the richest coral reefs anywhere, plus birds-of-paradise found nowhere else.
costOverview: Raja Ampat has no cheap version — even a budget liveaboard runs several hundred dollars a day before mandatory park fees, and luxury boats charge well over that.

birding.label: Calm seas for remote birding sites
